question: Does SRC-1EE58A703971 represent the Ford 2002 article, and who does the checked publication record identify as its author?

records_checked.finding: The imported row points to OpenAlex work W2513894189, but classified that metadata landing record as an article and cited Christa Müller-Kessler as author.

The live OpenAlex work record identifies the title Another Look at Mandaic Incantation Bowl BM 91715, publication year 2002, and authorship Jane Ford. It is a discovery-metadata record, not an acquired reading copy.
The journal record represented by SRC-FORD2002-JANES identifies J. N. Ford as author and Journal of the Ancient Near Eastern Society 29 as the publication.
The author's institutional publication record identifies J. Ford, journal volume 29, pages 31–47, and publication year 2002.

determination: SRC-1EE58A703971 is retained as an OpenAlex repository-metadata source and corrected to the current metadata attribution. SRC-FORD2002-JANES remains the bibliographic record for the article by J. N. Ford. The old imported state is retained verbatim in the source-correction ledger.
limits: This review resolves bibliographic attribution only. It does not inspect the full article, adjudicate a bowl reading, merge an identity, or authorize text or media publication.
